exchanges.outcome: User was right. Two scaffold assumptions were wrong: the palette is ColorBrewer Spectral (warm 6 of 11, reversed), not YlOrRd; and the scale is quantized (exactly 6 distinct colors across 250 cells), not continuous. Domain [18, 39] — the data max plus 2 — reproduces the reference exactly; plain d3.extent moves 40% of cells one class. Verified 252/252 cells identical.
exchanges.correction_made: Reversed the exchange-11 recommendation: the per-metric extent is required, and the scale must therefore stay inside render() rather than being hoisted.
